entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: This is a bellboy uniform, correct?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Carrying the customers' items, as well as[n]guiding them when you need to...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Are you going to ask me to carry your[n]things...? There's no way that's happening.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I am Phoenix Ranger Neo-Featherman,[n]Feather Silver.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Ah, this takes me back. I used to watch it[n]when I was little.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Funny in hindsight. It's always the team's[n]most recent ally who seems to be the[n]strongest of the bunch, isn't it?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I decided to try on the Demonica helmet,[n]Joker.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Isn't this amazing? It may look strange, but[n]it's actually quite comfortable.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm surprised you could tell it was me.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Or, wait... Perhaps you didn't recognize me[n]after all?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm in the Demonica suit.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Since it fits perfectly, it's easy to move[n]around in when investigating.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Where in the world did you get these?[n]They'd be better suited to an army...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: *chuckle* Only kidding. It's not good to be[n]nosey, after all. But don't worry, I'm sure I[n]can find out on my own.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I've changed outfits, but... what exactly is[n]this?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Since my head is bigger, the nose on my[n]mask is heavier than expected...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Please let me take it off.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Joker-senpai, I'm in my summer clothes.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I have a pretty good metabolism,[n]and I prefer the cold, so these are[n]more comfortable for me.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm in my uniform!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I don't mind my Phantom Thieves outfit,[n]but my school uniform is my favorite[n]personally.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm in my casual clothing.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: What do you think? Does this look good on[n]me?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I personally like clothes with polka dots... It[n]feels like every time I look in my closet I have[n]more and more of them.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm in my winter clothes.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Do I look good in them?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: When I wear clothes with warm colors,[n]I feel a little warmer even in cooler areas.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm in my gym clothing.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I do like leotards, but these gym clothes[n]aren't too bad either.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: They're actually very useful! They keep me[n]cool, and sweat dries up pretty quickly in[n]them.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm in my swimsuit, Senpai.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It's great for swimming, but I can't help but[n]feel kind of embarrassed...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: By the way, Joker-senpai... Why is it that you[n]have my swimsuit?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Joker-senpai. I'm trying on the uniform[n]from Gekkoukan High School.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Gekkoukan is known for putting a lot of[n]effort into their sports clubs. Especially[n]their kendo, track, and swim teams.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Oh, and I think their tennis and volleyball[n]teams too... A-Anyways, their sports teams[n]are very strong!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm in Yasogami High School's uniform.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I've heard that you can get this delicious[n]beef bowl there...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: But if I'm thinking of my weight, it's not[n]something I should eat right now... I do[n]want to have it someday, though!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: When that time comes, let's go there[n]together, Joker-senpai!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm in St. Hermelin High School's uniform.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: This is the first time I've ever worn a necktie.[n]It's actually pretty nice.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I like the little design on my left shoulder.[n]Is this a little picture of a weasel?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm in the Seven Sisters uniform.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It kind of looks like Shujin Academy's[n]uniform, doesn't it? How do I look?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm in a different outfit, Joker-senpai.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: This sailor outfit one piece, the bob cut wig...[n]It's all so cute and girly!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Oh, and there's this bracelet, too... Do you[n]think this stone has some kind of power?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: This outfit really strikes a chord with me!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm in Karukozaka High School's uniform.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: This machinery on my arm, and the[n]headphones... Are those all part of the[n]uniform?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Do they use this during class? The school[n]must have a lot of technology...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm in a maid outfit, Joker-senpai!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I won't ask why you have this.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: What is it they say again? Good work today,[n]Master!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Wait, is that right...?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm trying on my Christmas costume,[n]Senpai!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Um, h-how do I look? I've never tried[n]clothes like this, so I was a bit worried.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Do you like it? Hee hee, thank goodness!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm in the Shadow Ops uniform!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: What do you think, Senpai? I feel older than[n]you when I wear these clothes!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: You can leave the Shadow elimination to[n]me! Just say the word!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I've changed into my samurai outfit.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It's a little different from what I imagined,[n]but I think this looks pretty cool.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It allows for more movement than a[n]hakama would anyway.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I changed into Ouran High's uniform.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: This kind of wine red color is pretty unusual[n]for a school uniform.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It seems pretty mature for a high school[n]student... I think it looks pretty cool.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Senpai, I'm in my dancing outfit.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I've only ever danced at the school festival,[n]but it sure was fun!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I bet dancing more would help with my[n]routines, so maybe I'll give it a try!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: RESERVE

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm trying on a different outfit, Joker-senpai.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: This is an elevator girl's outfit, right?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Going up. Hee hee, just kidding.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: This color is wonderful. I like it!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm Phoenix Ranger Neo-Featherman,[n]Feather White!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I've always admired the stuntmen who[n]wear these outfits and act out the stunts...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Oh! Wouldn't it be great to do backflips[n]and cartweels during a routine?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Oh, Joker-senpai.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Um, can I at least take off this helmet in the[n]safe rooms?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It's not that it's heavy... It's just a little[n]embarrassing...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm in a Demonica suit!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It's so mobile and sturdy! It keeps me[n]warm, but it also lets the air through!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I think I'll use this as my practice gear.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Oh, but I'll pass on the helmet.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Joker-senpai, what is this outfit?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: My head is getting heavy... Do I really have[n]to keep wearing this?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Don't blame me if I lose balance and hit you[n]instead!
